title: Some unused vaccine funds diverted to patient aid – Deputy Speaker Garin

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Billions of pesos in unused vaccine funds prompted the House of Representatives to redirect part of the proposed 2027 immunization budget to medical assistance for patients. Garin, a former health secretary, said funds for influenza and pneumococcal vaccines remained unused despite the urgent need to protect Filipinos against preventable diseases. “For example, the flu vaccine budget was not touched. The 2025 funds have not been used. The 2026 funds have not been used,” Garin said in Filipino during the “Saturday News Forum” at Dapo Restaurant in Quezon City, referring to unused funds for flu and pneumococcal vaccines for children.
